notes.b1/j1/C-r1: Elegant tall classic lamp with rocket cap, glowing pool and soft merging wax, minimal controls below; wax is a bit murky and low contrast.
notes.b1/j1/R-r1: Convincing classic lamp with purple liquid, glowing hot wax that stretches and splits, chrome base with indicator and floor glow, tidy control bar.
notes.b1/j1/A-r1: Brass lamp with discrete flat pink blobs that merge a bit, but the glass is dark and flat, the wax is sparse and the panel dominates.
notes.b1/j1/R-r2: Good rosy glass and copper base, but the wax is mostly one lumpy mass with a single orbiting ball, so the motion is less organic.
notes.b1/j1/A-r2: Wax reads as a big flat orange mass filling the lower glass and the tiny cap is odd; switching off blacks out the whole lamp, breaking the illusion.
notes.b1/j1/C-r2: Pretty bulbous glass with highlights and warm ambient glow and believable column of wax, though the shape is less iconic and the wax is monotone.
notes.b1/j2/R-r2: Clear lamp with cap, base and glow, but the wax is a single fuzzy lump with a small dot, little merging or splitting, and the panel is generic.
notes.b1/j2/A-r2: Wax reads as a soft orange fill with hard-edged flat-cut glass and a cap that looks inverted, though the stretching and splitting is organic; the lamp goes dark when turned off.
notes.b1/j2/C-r2: Bulbous glass vessel with highlights, believable stretching wax column and a thoughtful panel; the shape is less classic but richly crafted.
notes.b1/j2/A-r1: Crisp metaballs that merge and split read nicely, but flat vector fill, a dark void in the glass and a tiny pooled puddle make it less luminous.
notes.b1/j2/R-r1: Classic silhouette with chrome cap and base, glowing hot-core wax that stretches and merges slowly, and a clean toolbar, though the wax edges are slightly pixelated.
notes.b1/j2/C-r1: Most atmospheric glass, glow and base with warm light from below, but the wax is murky and low-contrast and tends to fuse into one glowing mass.
notes.b1/j3/A-r2: Tapered lamp with a base and cap, but the wax is one big flat orange mass with a hard edge that rises and falls like a tide rather than separate blobs.
notes.b1/j3/C-r2: Pretty glass bulb with warm glow and a believable stretching, merging wax column, but the bulb silhouette reads more as a genie bottle than a classic lava lamp.
notes.b1/j3/R-r2: Recognizable tapered lamp with a copper base, but the wax mostly sits as a lump at the bottom with one lone small ball and barely evolves.
notes.b1/j3/C-r1: Elegant glass, bullet cap and glowing base with a restrained layout, but the wax is hazy and muddy inside the glass and the controls are small.
notes.b1/j3/A-r1: Crisp, vivid blobs that stretch and merge nicely, but the glass interior is flat dark, the brass base is plain and wax mostly pools at the bottom.
notes.b1/j3/R-r1: Classic lava lamp with chrome cap and base, purple liquid, hot glowing wax column that stretches, pinches and merges organically, with a clean control bar.
notes.b2/j1/C-r3: Classic tapered glass with chrome cap and hourglass base, wax stretches and merges convincingly and the heat/cooling interaction works.
notes.b2/j1/R-r3: Gorgeous warm glow and glass, but the wax quickly collapses into a pool and a cap-clump with very few blobs travelling.
notes.b2/j1/A-r3: Pixelated blocky wax edges, murky dark glass and one big lump that barely moves make it the weakest.
notes.b2/j1/R-r4: Amber liquid with red wax blobs, brass base with a switch and good glow, blobs drift and merge organically.
notes.b2/j1/A-r4: Readable lava lamp with glowing magma blobs, but the vessel is plain and the base flat.
notes.b2/j1/C-r4: Elegant purple lamp with fluted base and strong lighting, though the pink blobs are uniformly soft circles and the controls are tiny.
notes.b2/j2/R-r4: Brass lamp with warm amber glow and soft red wax that stretches and merges, with a tasteful switch on the base.
notes.b2/j2/A-r4: Clean chrome and purple lamp with a nice pink glow, but wax is flat pink blobs and the vessel is a bit plain.
notes.b2/j2/C-r4: Elegant purple lamp with a bottom glow and neat control bar, but the pink wax is soft fuzzy balls that cluster at the top.
notes.b2/j2/A-r3: Pixelated jagged wax edges, dark empty glass and a lone big blob that stalls at the top make it look unfinished.
notes.b2/j2/R-r3: Most beautiful glowing glass and bubbling molten pool, but the wax collapses into one stuck mass at the top and blobs run out.
notes.b2/j2/C-r3: Most convincing lava lamp: violet liquid, glowing amber blobs that rise, merge, split and pool, on a polished chrome base.
notes.b2/j3/A-r4: Clear lamp with silver cap and base and a soft magenta glow, but the glass is flat, the wax is a plain pink-orange and the blobs mostly clump.
notes.b2/j3/C-r4: Beautiful violet glass, glow and hourglass base with a tidy control bar, though the blobs are small, fuzzy and bunch at the top.
notes.b2/j3/R-r4: Warm amber liquid, brass base with a switch and a cohesive staging; the red wax blobs drift and merge organically and cooling works.
notes.b2/j3/C-r3: Strong silver-capped lamp with glowing wax puddle, wax that rises, merges and sinks in convincing gooey shapes, and responsive stir and cool-down.
notes.b2/j3/A-r3: Pixelated metaball edges, a dark glass with no real glow, and the wax settles into one static blob that barely moves.
notes.b2/j3/R-r3: Gorgeous glowing bell-cap lamp with a hot pool, but the wax all migrates to the top and stays there, leaving one blob and little life.
